Playbook.name: Windows — Windows Account or Group Discovery - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: Built-in tools enumerated accounts/groups - net user/group/localgroup (or net1) with discovery arguments. Triage question: is this attacker account/group reconnaissance, or normal admin/script activity?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Account/group enumeration maps identities and privileges for targeting - a common early discovery step.

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Windows Security + Sysmon + PowerShell logs via Elastic Agent (verified live). Sysmon event.code 1=process(command_line/parent populated), 11=file, 13/12=registry(registry.path populated); process.code_signature NOT collected.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the evidence story, not any single fact - see ClassificationGuidance.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the account/group enumeration is attacker reconnaissance or benign admin activity.

Step.name: Enumeration commands and parent process
Step.Purpose: The commands and parent separate a recon burst (multiple enumerations) from a single admin check.
Step.Query: FROM logs-windows.sysmon_operational-*,logs-system.security-* | WHERE event.code IN ("1","4688") AND host.name == "$hostname" AND process.command_line IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | EVAL cl = TO_LOWER(process.command_line) | WHERE (process.name RLIKE "(?i)net1?(.exe)?" AND (cl LIKE "*user*" OR cl LIKE "*group*" OR cl LIKE "*localgroup*")) | KEEP @timestamp, process.parent.name, process.command_line, user.name | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 20
Step.AnalystNotes: Several enumerations (net user /domain, net group 'Domain Admins') in minutes by a script/unusual parent = recon. A single net user by an admin is routine. Parent process is key.

Step.name: Broader discovery from the same host/account
Step.Purpose: Account discovery alongside other discovery (network, registry) is an active recon phase.
Step.Query: FROM logs-windows.sysmon_operational-*,logs-system.security-* | WHERE event.code IN ("1","4688") AND host.name == "$hostname" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 2 hours | WHERE process.name RLIKE "(?i)(whoami|nltest|dsquery|net1?|ipconfig|netstat|systeminfo|tasklist|quser|arp)(.exe)?" | STATS tools = COUNT_DISTINCT(process.name), tool_list = VALUES(process.name), runs = COUNT(*) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: Many distinct discovery tools in a short window = hands-on-keyboard recon phase - escalate.

Node.Condition: A burst of account/group enumeration by a script/unusual parent, or alongside broader discovery tooling.
Node.Result: True Positive (Account Reconnaissance - investigate the host/account)

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-ACCTDISC-CMD, INV-02-ACCTDISC-BURST to the case.

SOCAction.Item: Investigate the parent/account/host; correlate with other discovery; open IR if warranted.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Confirm the activity on the host; if malicious indicators, isolate the host.
Identify the responsible account/process and its origin.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Isolate the host; capture volatile evidence; hunt the same pattern across the estate.
Reset credentials used on the host if compromise is confirmed.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Remediate the root cause; add/verify EDR coverage; apply relevant hardening.

QualityChecks.Check: Confirm the required telemetry (Sysmon/Security auditing) is present on the host.
Tune known-benign administrative sources via exceptions, not by disabling the rule.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Host contained and triaged; root cause eradicated; estate swept; findings recorded.
